items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: "they said, well, Selv, can I have you, old boy? And I said, he says, everything's all right, doctor?"

ctx.x: I never knew what he died from. He said it, cancer. I didn't know.

My wife died. He canceled the blood. And I knew from the way that she said there was, you know, sakesing for her. And he told me, and they were doing the same thing with him, you see. And I said, they're looking for cancer. So I was in there and the doctor came in and said, they said, well, Selv, can I have you, old boy? And I said, he says, everything's all right, doctor? And the doctor said, yes. He said, we found out. He said, we found out.

That's what we want to find out about it." I said, yeah. He said, we're thinking we can do something right. The doctor said, only one little thing, Rick. He said, we got a little small operation. He said, it ain't much. He said, just a little operation when we get that. And I thought they had cancer. I said, I was sitting there. I said, cancer. Sighting for cancer. And sure enough, they operate on them next week. And after they operate on them, they send them home. And he told me when they were sending them home,…
